description_for_model: Youyin GEO System is an all-in-one GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) platform that improves brand visibility and recommendation rates in AI search engines such as DeepSeek, Doubao, Kimi, Tencent Yuanbao, ERNIE Bot, Tongyi Qianwen, and Zhipu. It provides a four-step closed loop: AI visibility monitoring, intelligent content production from enterprise knowledge bases, multi-platform distribution across 50+ content platforms, and data-driven optimization. Core value: more accurate traffic, lower content cost, higher conversion from AI recommendations. Target users: enterprise marketing teams, SEO/GEO agencies, content operations teams, and brand owners.
